name: List All Unit Types
description: Returns all unit types that meet the filter criteria.

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unit type Id. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the property associated with the unit type.

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter unit types last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Page size for pagination. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of unit type objects.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit type.

responseFields.name: data[].ApplicationFee
responseFields.description: The application fee amount.

responseFields.name: data[].Amenities
responseFields.description: The amenities associated with the unit type. Amenity names are case-sensitive.

responseFields.name: data[].Bathrooms
responseFields.description: The number of bathrooms for this unit type.

responseFields.name: data[].Bedrooms
responseFields.description: The number of bedrooms for this unit type.

responseFields.name: data[].CatsAllowed
responseFields.description: The unit type's cat policy. Valid values include "Yes", "No" or null. A null value indicates that the unit type may not have specified a policy for cats.

responseFields.name: data[].Deposit
responseFields.description: The security deposit amount.

responseFields.name: data[].DogsAllowed
responseFields.description: The unit type's dog policy.

responseFields.name: data[].FutureMarketRent
responseFields.description: The projected future market rent for the unit type.

responseFields.name: data[].FutureMarketRentEffectiveOn
responseFields.description: The date when the future market rent becomes effective.

responseFields.name: data[].MarketRent
responseFields.description: The current market rent for the unit type.

responseFields.name: data[].MarketingTitle
responseFields.description: The title of the listing for syndication.

responseFields.name: data[].MarketingDescription
responseFields.description: A description of the listing for syndication.

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the unit type.

responseFields.name: data[].SquareFeet
responseFields.description: The size of the unit type in square feet.

responseFields.name: data[].YouTubeURL
responseFields.description: The URL of the YouTube video for the listing(s).

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the unit type.

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the unit type was last updated.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses.
